memoryBuilder.verseText: Be quick to listen, slow to speak, slow to get angry.

sequence.prompt: What do we do when anger knocks? Put it in order.

items.label: Anger knocks — I go hot inside
I stop and take four slow breaths
I tell God and a grown-up how I feel
I go and put it right today

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: A real feeling — Jesus felt it too
It waits — but you can rule it
Full of mercy and slow to get angry

application.question: When anger knocks today, what will you do first?

options.label: Tell a grown-up how I feel

application.followUp: God asked Cain a kind question before anything happened, so He is not waiting to catch you out when you feel cross. He is slow to get angry with us, every single day. Ask Him for the same patience and He will grow it in you. Slow to get angry.
